fr_contacter_verb.hook: A red-beret mime calls through a tin-can telephone and holds a cup of tea (kohn-tahk-TAY).

fr_composer_verb.hook: A gray cat walks the piano keys while the mime composes (kohn-poh-ZAY).

fr_exprimer_verb.hook: A red-beret mime leaps under white blossom and holds a hand mirror, because s'exprimer is pronominal (ehk-spree-MAY).

fr_former_verb.hook: A red-beret mime forms a clay vase on a wheel beside a goose (for-MAY).

fr_rappeler_verb.hook: A red-beret mime in sunglasses and a gold chain calls back on an old telephone (rah-puh-LAY).

fr_sonner_verb.hook: A red-beret mime sounds a horn and a white horse neighs (soh-NAY).

fr_inscrire_verb.hook: A gold-beret mime chisels a blank plaque and gravel falls (ans-KREER).

fr_utiliser_verb.hook: A red-beret mime and an orange octopus wash a window with sponges (ew-tee-lee-ZAY).

fr_indiquer_verb.hook: A red-beret mime points the way and a white duck stands beside him (an-dee-KAY).

fr_affirmer_verb.hook: A red-beret mime gives a firm nod beside a goat with a bell and flowers (ah-feer-MAY).

fr_informer_verb.hook: A red-beret mime holds four daisies to pass on the news (an-for-MAY).

fr_taire_verb.hook: A gold-beret mime holds a hand mirror while a mouse tears a bag beside a sleeping cat, because se taire is pronominal (TEHR).

fr_engager_verb.hook: A bear in a red beret hires a raccoon with a handshake at the garage (ahn-gah-ZHAY).

fr_murmurer_verb.hook: A red-beret mime murmurs to a bow-tied stingray (mewr-mew-RAY).

fr_realiser_verb.hook: A bulldog in a red beret directs with a cone beside a blank clapper (ray-ah-lee-ZAY).

fr_adresser_verb.hook: A cat in a map dress and a red beret stands by a hand mirror, because s'adresser is pronominal (ah-dray-SAY).

fr_interroger_verb.hook: A red-beret mime in a deerstalker questions a goldfish in a bowl (an-teh-roh-ZHAY).

fr_avouer_verb.hook: A red-beret mime bows beside a dog with cake crumbs and an empty plate (ah-VWAY).
